text: Bon. I've rung twice already and nobody has called me back so I'm writing it all down here, j'en ai marre honnêtement. I'm a foster carer and I've got a little boy, 5 months old, been with us a few weeks now. Tonight his temperature was 37.6, I checked it twice to be sure. He's got some insect bites on his legs and one on his arm, petites piqûres, they're itchy and he keeps rubbing his legs together on the mat. I did the glass test on them because the social worker told us always to do that, and they go pale and fade straight away under the glass, so c'est bon for that at least. No fits, no shaking or jerking, nothing like that at all. What I need to know is what I can actually put on the bites for a baby this small, because I don't want to use anything I'm not allowed to, and whether I need to do anything about the 37.6 or just leave it. Franchement it shouldn't take this long to get an answer to a simple question, I've been sitting here waiting for over an hour. Merci quand même.
